title: File:Ordnance Survey. Conventional Signs and Writing for the Revised One-Inch Map of Great Britain. (Popular Edition) (IA dr ordnance-survey-conventional-signs-and-writing-for-the-revised-one-inch-ma-7805152).jpg
author:
Great Britain. Ordnance Survey

description:
Zoomable full resolution image available at davidrumsey.com.This image 7805.152 is a part of image group 7805.000.Shows all the symbols used in the Popular Edition maps.Set of 146 sheets of which 144 sheets are flat on paper, 2 sheets (#145 and #146) mounted on linen and folded with covers. Legend on each sheet. Full color. Relief shown by contours. Sheets include, "Published by Colonel Sir Charles Close, K.B.F., C.B., C.M.G. Director General" or "Published by Colonel Commendant E.M. Jack, C.M.G., D.S.O., Director General." Comparing this set to our later "New Popular One-Inch Map with National Grid, England and Wales" of 1947 (see our 6917.000) one can see many changes both in the urban areas expanding and in the adoption by the Ordnance Survey of the National Grid.Hodson, Yolande. 1999. Popular Maps, The Ordnance Survey Popular Edition One-Inch Map of England and Wales, 1919-1926. London: The Charles Close Society.
